summary.text: Marilyn John is a Republican state representative from Mansfield who has represented Ohio House District 76 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She was selected as House majority leader effective January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: John graduated from Plymouth High School and earned an associate degree in business management from North Central State College, followed by a bachelor's degree in business management and marketing and an M.B.A. from Ashland University.
Her career included work as a commercial lines underwriter with the Shelby Insurance Company and as executive director of the Shelby Senior Center.
Ballotpedia lists her Ohio House tenure as beginning in 2021.
She won the November 5, 2024 general election against Emily Adams and Tim Grady.
Her committees include Finance, General Government, Judiciary, Workforce and Higher Education, Insurance, and Rules and Reference.
Colton Stidam is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
